property_summary: For any caller equal to the current depositorAccount and any batcher hash input, setL1BlockValues must leave the public batcherHash getter unchanged (zero), since the reference never stores it; the mutant stores _batcherHash, breaking the rule for any nonzero hash.
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _batcherHash into the state variable batcherHash after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public batcherHash() getter.
